warnings: No outage probabilities or rates are known: event counts are WHAT-IF assumptions.
20-year PV of SELECTED cost streams is NOT full NPC, since normal grid operation, site load electricity, system degradation, maintenance downtime, charger costs, taxes and permits are omitted.
Inherited unit costs, fixed O&M and replacement timing are NOT supplier quotations.

Fuel consumed is charged once as replenishment stock; accepted delivery litres receive only an incremental transport premium. Trip dispatch fee is charged for each scheduled delivery even if tank headroom rejects fuel.
Critical/noncritical ENS shadow prices are sensitivity preferences, NOT real tariff/compensation amounts.
Every 168h outage starts with a full 2000L tank, 70% SOC, and inherited 2025 meteorological/load traces; repeated-event PVs are NOT independent annual operations forecasts.
